target.description: Independent first-principles review of project-knowledge/control architecture residency, ownership, reuse and instantiation before ChatGPT freezes a topology recommendation.

known_exposures: Claude receives the neutral residency/reuse question and exact pre-candidate repository evidence.
Research 236, Research 237, Checkpoint 567, descendant CURRENT_STATE/KNOWLEDGE_MAP synthesis and future PKIA candidate material are excluded before Message 001.
Earlier Research 177/218 and Research 219-235 are intentionally available because they are pre-candidate evidence needed to understand the current architecture and control-plane growth.

Claude may use its preserved claude-03 context from MC-0011 through MC-0018; prior participation in the project-knowledge architecture is intentionally treated as useful historical context, not contamination.
independence.notes: Independence is candidate-blind rather than history-blind. The persistent claude-03 architecture-design session is intentionally reused because its MC-0011 through MC-0018 context can expose assumptions and rationale from the architecture it helped design. Claude may independently derive any topology, including project-native, external, materialized, hybrid or another design, but is not shown ChatGPT's new PKIA-E01 topology framing before Message 001.

last_transition.reason: Before any Claude response, the owner challenged the planned fresh claude-04 session. The review now intentionally reuses persistent claude-03 so earlier project-knowledge architecture context remains available while blindness is preserved only against the new PKIA-E01 residency framing and candidate.
